verdict.rationale: A game-engine editor could plausibly ship an MCP client (for example, an in-editor AI assistant), so this axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party ability to plug MCP servers into Godot. The community MCP repos and the built-in GDScript LSP point the other way: they let external agents reach Godot, which is a server or adjacent role, not Godot consuming MCP tools. Editor plugins and GDExtension are only developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
